# Palm & Tide

> Palm & Tide is a boutique travel curator based in Diani, Kenya, designing complete coastal journeys — accommodation, style, ocean excursions and cultural connection — planned before guests arrive.

## About
Palm & Tide curates trusted local stays, ocean excursions, coastal fashion and cultural connections along Kenya's Swahili Coast in Diani. Each journey is built from four "tides": Stay by the Tide (accommodation), Find Your Style (coastal fashion & accessories), Follow the Tide (ocean excursions), and Meet the Coast (village & cultural connection).

Contact: WhatsApp +254 700 009 988 · Email hello.palmtides@gmail.com · TikTok @palmtideexperience

## Packages
- The 3-Day Diani Escape — 3 days — price on request. A short coastal getaway, ideal for long weekends.
- The 5-Day Diani Adventure — 5 days / 4 nights — price on request. Our signature, most-booked package: a curated stay, local styling, a dolphin and snorkelling excursion, a village e-bike tour, and a surprise experience courtesy of Palm & Tide. Full itinerary: https://palmandtideexperience.com/five-day-coast-adventure.html
- The 7-Day Diani Immersion — 7 days — price on request. A slower-paced week along the coast for travellers who want to relax rather than rush.
- Family Journeys — flexible duration — price on request. Planned around children and parents together, not just extra beds.
- Team Building — flexible duration — price on request. Group retreats built for teams, not tourists.
